items.info: Overhead Panel. BATT switch ON and LOCKED. Battery voltage at least 25 V.

items.info: Overhead Panel. Verify EXT PWR AVAIL light ON and 115 ±3 V, 400 ±10 Hz. L and R EXT PWR bus switches ON, one at a time. Switch them OFF once the APU buses are on.

items.info: Main Panel. APU and ENG LOOP selectors (Overhead Panel) all to BOTH. Push both LOOP A and B TEST buttons (mouse wheel). Fire handle lights, MASTER WARNING, APU FIRE and the aural warning come on. Release; all go out.
items.label: Fire Protection

items.info: Overhead Panel. Start Pump ON. APU Master to START. APU STARTER ON goes out at 35% RPM, APU OIL PRESS LOW goes out above 95%. APU Master to RUN. APU PWR AVAIL lights ON, EGT 200-400°. L and R APU bus switches ON, one at a time. Right AFT fuel pump ON. Start Pump OFF. APU AIR ON.
items.label: APU

items.info: Overhead Panel. Damps out dutch roll, the wallowing yaw-roll oscillation swept-wing jets are prone to. Set and forget.
items.label: Yaw Damper

items.info: Cabin Pressure Control Panel. Selector to STBY, then PRIMARY. Click the TRANSFER LOCKOUT light OFF. Set LDG ALT to destination elevation and LDG BARO to destination pressure, or set BARO later before landing.

items.info: Glareshield. Set both VHF NAV radios to an ILS frequency (for example 109.50). Push the AUTOLAND button. NO AUTOLAND flashes and the FMA reads AUTO LND PRE FLT TEST. After about 50 seconds the FMA goes blank (or back to its previous display) and NO AUTOLAND goes out, which means the test passed.
